result_text:
The per-rep purchase order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The fix is in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, where the subquery gets the same `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` filter the other purchase-order and per-rep queries already use. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.

I added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` to `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`, modelled on your example: Anna gets 1 and Bob gets 1 once two cancelled South orders are excluded. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests) with `mvn -o`. I did not run the new test against the unfixed query, and I did not run the wider suite.

Nothing is committed.
